Invent an original subdued dark grey-brown granular surface, sparse irregular blocks and shallow pitted relief, gently curved distant horizon under black sky. The existence, scale and material of all local grains, rocks, chemistry, fractions, porosity, colour and lighting are invented: do not depict them as measured. No astronomical disks in this local view; Jupiter and Sun are outside frame. Do not reuse or imitate any observed body's terrain, map, photograph or distinctive geographic feature, including Moon, Mars, Pluto, Amalthea or any other moon. Do not reconstruct Zethus or identify a dated place. No atmosphere haze, plume, liquid, exposed ocean, biology, craft, astronaut or survivable landing implication. Black sky and omitted stars do not establish atmosphere or star absence. Photographic-style scientific hypothetical illustration, restrained contrast and legible surfaces, exposure artistic. THEBE — IMAGINED LOCAL VIEW
Terrain, materials, colour and lighting invented; no registered surface site
Keep both lines completely inside image, unobstructed, without additional labels, logos or watermarks. Render a new standalone image without reference images.
